transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I’ve just been really tired. Like… more than normal. Sleep doesn’t seem to fix it, and getting through work and then dinner at home feels harder than it should.
How long have you been feeling this tired?
About a month, I think. It started after a stretch where I felt… unusually driven, and then I kind of dropped into this low, tired state that hasn’t really lifted.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time since you started feeling tired?
Yeah… most days. I wake up and it’s just this heavy, gray feeling, like the day is already going to be disappointing. I don’t really know how else to put it.
Have you been enjoying things you normally like to do?
Not really. I usually like painting, and going to museum exhibits, but lately my supplies just sit there. I don’t really feel like going, or… care enough to start.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or look forward to?
Not much, honestly. I used to really look forward to painting or just wandering around a museum, but lately I just… don’t. My supplies sit there, and I can’t seem to care enough to go anywhere.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?

Yeah… I guess I have. I keep going over little things—missed plans with my family, awkward conversations with my husband. It just makes me feel like I’m not really doing a good job… as a wife, a mom, even at work. Like I’m letting people down.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?
I’m not sure… maybe a little sometimes, but I haven’t really been thinking of it that way. I wouldn’t say it’s been the main thing.
Are there any small pleasures in your daily life that you still enjoy?
Not really. I mean… painting used to be a small thing I enjoyed, or going through museum exhibits, but lately I just leave my supplies there and don’t really feel pulled toward any of it.
Have you noticed any changes in how quickly or slowly you're moving lately?
A little, I guess. My staff has mentioned I’m slower to answer in meetings… like there’s this pause before I can get my thoughts into words.
Have you lost any weight recently?
Maybe a little. I haven’t weighed myself much, but I’ve been skipping lunch or just picking at food… and some of my skirts feel looser. I’m not trying to lose weight.
Have you been having any thoughts about not wanting to live or hurting yourself?
I don’t think so. I mean… I’ve had rough days, but I haven’t been thinking about hurting myself.
Have you been feeling restless or fidgety, or is it more that you're having trouble getting started on things?
More trouble getting started, I think. Not really fidgety. It’s like… in meetings, people ask me something and there’s this pause before I can get my thoughts into words. My staff has noticed it.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than usual in your daily activities?
A little, maybe. Mostly people notice it when I’m answering questions at work… there’s this pause before I can get my thoughts into words. My staff has picked up on it.
Have you been experiencing any unusual thoughts or hearing voices that others don't?
No… I haven’t heard voices or anything like that. I don’t think I’ve had unusual thoughts, at least not in that way.
Have you had any days in the past month where you felt somewhat better, or has it been consistently bad?
It’s been mostly bad lately. Maybe… about a month now. Before that I had a stretch where I felt a lot more energized and driven, but then it dropped off and hasn’t really lifted much.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than usual in your daily activities?
Yes… like I said, it’s more noticeable when I’m trying to answer people. In meetings, my staff has noticed there’s this pause before I can get my thoughts into words.
Have you had any difficulty concentrating on things like reading or watching TV?
Yes… mostly at work. I’ll have a simple staffing email open and I just reread it over and over. I can’t seem to decide what to say, or which option makes sense.
Do you feel like you're moving or reacting more slowly than you usually do in your daily life?
Yes… I think so. Mostly people at work notice it. In meetings there’s this pause before I can answer, like my thoughts are moving slower than usual.
Have you had any significant changes in appetite?
A little, I guess. I’ve been sort of picking at meals… sometimes I forget lunch at work. My skirts feel a bit looser, but I haven’t been trying to lose weight.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you felt nearly back to your normal self?

Not really. It’s been… maybe about a month of this whole shift. I had a stretch where I was much more energized and driven, and then it kind of dropped into this low, and I haven’t felt fully normal in the last couple weeks.
